experimental_design.evidence: inferred: Deletion and duplication of the 16p11.2 genomic locus are associated with opposing changes in brain size. To determine cellular mechanisms that might underlie these opposing phenotypes, we performed quantitative phosphoproteomics on induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSC) derived neural progenitor cells (NPCs) obtained from unaffected individuals, 16p11.2 deletion, and duplication carriers.
